ad_lease_trap.text: The landlord slides a lease across the table. The font is small. The clauses are not.

outcomes.fine: The lease turns out to be ordinary. You feel lucky and slightly stupid.
outcomes.fees: Page six contained a "move-out enhancement fee." It enhances nothing.

ad_gym_signup.text: A gym offers a year of membership for the price of a decent bicycle. The receptionist is very tan and very patient.

ad_roommate_fridge.text: Someone has eaten your labeled leftovers. The label said "Mine." It was underlined twice.

ad_first_apartment_mouse.text: Something small and determined lives in your wall. You have named it. This was a mistake.

outcomes.caught: The trap works. You feel like a villain in a very small story.
outcomes.nothing: The trap catches only your thumb. The mouse remains unbothered.

ad_stranger_wallet_train.text: A stranger on the train falls asleep and drops a phone. It is buzzing with someone else's life.

outcomes.sold: You sell it for 300. The guilt costs extra and does not come with a receipt.
outcomes.tracked: It has tracking. Two officers wait at your stop. You pay a fine and a lot of dignity.

ad_volunteer_shelter.text: A flyer asks for weekend help at an animal shelter. The animals in the photo look like they know exactly what they are doing.

ad_free_stuff_curb.text: A "FREE" sign sits on a heap of furniture, lamps, and one suspicious rug. Everything is almost useful.

ad_back_pain_desk.text: Your lower back has started sending formal complaints. You have been sitting like a question mark for years.

outcomes.ok: The pain fades and returns, like a bad sequel.
outcomes.worse: It becomes a pinched nerve. The physiotherapist is kind and expensive.

ad_friend_moving.text: {{name}} is moving apartments and has a plan: you, a truck, and "just a few boxes." The boxes are books.

ad_friend_wedding_speech.text: {{name}} asks you to give a speech at their wedding. You have two weeks and one embarrassing story.

outcomes.moved: Half the room cries. {{name}} hugs you so hard your ribs file a report.
outcomes.flat: You lose your place twice. The applause is merciful.
outcomes.laughs: The room roars. {{name}} pretends to be furious, then isn't.
outcomes.oops: The story had a detail you forgot was a secret. Someone's aunt gasps.

ad_friend_road_trip.text: {{name}} proposes a spontaneous road trip. The car is old, the map is older, and the plan is a vibe.

outcomes.great: You sing badly at sunrise on a highway. It is perfect.
outcomes.breakdown: The car dies in a town with one diner. The repair is memorable and costly.

ad_mom_laundry_call.text: {{name}} calls to ask if you are eating "real food." You are holding a spoon over a pot of cereal.

ad_sibling_loan.text: {{name}} asks to borrow money. The amount is vague. The tone is not.

outcomes.repaid: {{name}} repays you within the year, with a card and a terrible pun.
outcomes.gone: The money vanishes. Holidays now involve careful eye contact.

ad_dad_advice.text: {{name}} offers advice about "the real world." It consists of a handshake and a battered set of tools.

ad_partner_move_in.text: {{name}} suggests moving in together. Your shared toothbrush holder is already a quiet commitment.

outcomes.bliss: Rent is halved and breakfast improves. You discover each other's loud habits with affection.
outcomes.friction: The dishes become a cold war. Neither of you knows where the good spatula went.

ad_phishing_prince.text: An email from a "royal accountant" promises you a fortune if you pay a small processing fee first. The grammar is a work of art.

outcomes.bait: The "prince" asks for more fees, then vanishes. Your bank account feels the loss.
outcomes.laugh: A few exchanges later it gets boring. You block them and feel clever.

ad_lottery_ticket.text: A scratch ticket sits by the register. The shopkeeper says "Someone has to win." Someone does. Rarely it's the person asking.

outcomes.jackpot: Six numbers line up. You check them four times. The shopkeeper checks them five.
outcomes.small: You win 200. It is the nicest little lie the lottery tells.
outcomes.nothing: Nothing. You scratch the card with a coin and a little less hope.

ad_lost_dog_stranger.text: A friendly dog with no tag follows you for three blocks. It has the dignity of someone who has made a decision.

outcomes.reunited: A tearful family collects the dog. A child gives you a drawing of a potato. It might be you.
outcomes.kept: No one claims the dog. It moves in as if it paid the deposit.

ad_friend_gossip.text: {{name}} leans in over coffee with news about someone you both know. It is too good to be useful.

outcomes.quiet: Nothing happens. You feel smaller anyway.
outcomes.backfire: The story gets back to the subject. It arrives with extra details and your name.

ad_weird_package.text: A package arrives addressed to you. You didn't order anything. The label says "fragile" and "do not open near water."

outcomes.gift: It is a gift from a distant relative: a vintage watch and a note that says "good luck."
outcomes.junk: Wooden ducks, forty of them. No note.
outcomes.trouble: It contains a returned item from a stranger's dispute. You get the bill.

ad_midlife_checkup.text: The doctor has "a few numbers to discuss." This is how every bad mood starts.

outcomes.improved: Three months of salad and walking later, the numbers move kindly.
outcomes.meh: You improve a little. The doctor nods like a coach.
outcomes.lucky: Nothing happens. You pretend it was a plan.
outcomes.bad: Six months later it becomes a procedure, and the numbers get louder.

ad_gym_plateau.text: Your gym membership has become a monthly ritual of paying for the building. The mirror has opinions.

ad_sudden_collapse.text: You feel odd climbing the stairs. Not terrible. Just wrong, like a tune played a half-step off.

outcomes.saved: Paramedics arrive fast. It was a warning shot and you hear it clearly.
outcomes.gone: The help arrives too late. A heart gives out without a speech.
outcomes.fine: It passes. You schedule a checkup you will probably delay.
outcomes.gone2: The feeling grows. You do not finish the stairs.

ad_hoard_garage.text: Your garage can no longer hold a car, a bike, or a believable excuse. A neighbor mentions the smell of cardboard.

ad_scam_followup.text: A caller offers to "recover your lost funds" for a small fee. You recognize the voice of someone who has done this before.

ad_neighbor_tree.text: A neighbor's tree hangs over your fence and drops things on your car. Politely. Constantly.

outcomes.friendly: They trim it and bring you a jar of jam. This is the best outcome.
outcomes.feud: They defend the tree like a family member. You are now in a feud.

ad_neighbor_party.text: Next door throws a loud party at midnight. The bass knows your name.

ad_tax_audit.text: A letter from the tax office wants "some clarifications." Your receipts live in a shoebox and a prayer.

outcomes.clear: You pay a modest accountant fee, and the audit closes politely.
outcomes.fine: A few mistakes cost you. The audit report is more humiliating than the money.

ad_roof_leak.text: A water stain blooms on the ceiling like a slow, damp flower. It was not on the inspection report.

outcomes.holds: The patch holds. You are briefly a builder.
outcomes.fails: The next storm turns the patch into a waterfall. The real repair costs double.

ad_aunt_windfall.text: A lawyer calls about a distant aunt you met twice. She left you "a sum" and a parrot.

outcomes.nice: A decent sum arrives. The parrot knows your name by the end of the week.
outcomes.small: Most of the estate goes to charity. You receive modest cash and a very loud bird.

ad_lottery_aftermath.text: Word of your winnings has spread. Old friends call. Distant cousins write poems about you.

outcomes.fun: You buy a boat, a piano, and a hat. You enjoy all three.
outcomes.regret: The money disappears into projects, favors, and one strange sailboat.

ad_friend_crisis.text: {{name}} calls late at night, voice thin. Their life has gone sideways and they need an ear.

ad_friend_reunion.text: {{name}} suggests a reunion dinner after years of "we should meet." Both of you have gained a little bit of everything.

ad_friend_pyramid.text: {{name}} invites you to an "exciting business opportunity." There is a slideshow. There is also a starter kit.

outcomes.loss: The kit sits in a closet. The "opportunity" is a shared debt.
outcomes.meh: You break even by the end of the year and swear never again.

ad_friend_birthday.text: {{name}} has a milestone birthday, and nobody has organized anything. You can feel the awkward silence from here.

ad_kid_tantrum.text: {{name}} has a magnificent meltdown in a grocery store over cereal. Strangers watch like it is a play.

ad_kid_school_play.text: {{name}} plays a tree in the school production. It is the finest tree in the history of drama.

ad_spouse_anniversary.text: Your anniversary arrives. {{name}} has not mentioned it, which is either a trap or a test.

outcomes.tasty: The dinner is edible and warm. {{name}} says it's the best they've had, which is generous.
outcomes.burnt: The smoke alarm sings. You order takeout and laugh until it's nearly dawn.

ad_partner_counseling.text: {{name}} suggests couples counseling. There are bad signs and a good chance of improvement.

outcomes.better: You learn how to argue without keeping score. The counselor has a plant. It helps.
outcomes.worse: Honesty arrives in bulk. Some of it is hard to put back.

ad_faith_question.text: A quiet doubt about the big questions settles over you. A neighbor invites you to a service, a community meal, and a free coffee.

ad_retirement_boredom.text: The mornings are long and the garden is surprisingly demanding. You have time and no plan.

outcomes.trip: You see seven cities and one genuinely great sandwich.
outcomes.rain: It rains the entire time. You collect souvenirs and mild resentment.

ad_grandkid_visit.text: {{name}} brings the grandchildren for the weekend. They treat your house like a research facility.

ad_mother_care.text: {{name}} is old and stubborn and needs more help than she will admit. She calls it "no trouble."

ad_sibling_reconcile.text: You and {{name}} haven't spoken properly in years. The reason has shrunk, but the silence has not.

outcomes.warm: The call lasts three hours. Neither of you remembers the argument.
outcomes.cold: They answer politely and hang up quickly. Some doors stay closed.

ad_spouse_dance.text: A song comes on in the kitchen. {{name}} holds out a hand, knees and all.

ad_partner_trip.text: {{name}} wants one more trip somewhere warm. They already bought hats.

ad_pension_scam.text: A voice on the phone says it's from your bank. It sounds helpful, urgent, and slightly rehearsed.

outcomes.sharp: The caller stumbles on the details and vanishes. You feel like a detective.
outcomes.slip: They had enough details to sound plausible. You find out too late.

ad_estate_planning.text: You sit in a lawyer's office discussing who gets the good china. The pen is heavier than expected.

ad_hip_fall.text: You step out of the shower and the floor has other plans. You land hard on your hip.

outcomes.recover: Surgery and weeks of rehab later, you walk with a cane and opinions.
outcomes.complications: Complications follow the surgery. The medical team does all it can.
outcomes.managed: You reach the phone eventually. The delay does not help.
outcomes.complications2: The long wait on the floor takes more than a body should give.

ad_cardiac_episode.text: Your chest feels tight at the breakfast table. The toast gets cold. You are not sure whether this is the dramatic kind of tight.

outcomes.stabilized: Doctors stabilize you. You stay four nights and master the hospital soup.
outcomes.arrest: Your heart stops en route. The paramedics try everything.
outcomes.passes: It passes. You pretend it was indigestion.
outcomes.arrest2: The pain does not pass. It is quiet, then it is not.

ad_pneumonia_winter.text: A winter cough turns into something heavier. You tell everyone it's "just a cold." Everyone knows better.

outcomes.treated: Antibiotics and rest do the work. You feel dramatically old for a week.
outcomes.fatal: The infection is stubborn. You slip away quietly, in a warm room.
outcomes.recovers: You recover slowly, with a deeper respect for soup.
outcomes.fatal2: The cough wins. Winter has a way of doing that.

ad_stairs_fall.text: The stairs look the same as always. Your balance does not. A misstep happens in half a second.

outcomes.saved: You catch yourself. Your heart does not forgive you for an hour.
outcomes.fall: The railing slips from your grip. It is a short fall with a long consequence.

ad_stroke_warning.text: Half your face goes numb while you're stirring tea. Your words arrive late and in the wrong order.

outcomes.recovers: Fast treatment saves most of what matters. Therapy is slow and humbling.
outcomes.stroke: The stroke is severe. The doctors are kind and honest.
outcomes.luck: It was a mild one. You are lucky and you know it.
outcomes.stroke2: Waiting costs time you did not have. The stroke takes the rest.

ad_surgery_decision.text: A surgeon explains a risky operation that could fix your problem. The odds are given in numbers, which helps and doesn't.

outcomes.success: The operation goes well. You wake up with a new lease on stairs.
outcomes.death: Complications arise on the table. The team does all it can.

ad_gym_senior.text: The young trainer says you are "an inspiration." You think you are a person who likes to stay upright.

ad_hoard_cleanup.text: Your child offers to help clean the house. Every object has a story, and each story is six hours long.

ad_faith_comfort.text: A quiet hour in your community's place of worship settles something. The people there ask after you by name.

ad_friend_funeral.text: {{name}}'s funeral is held on a sunny day, which feels like a rude detail. The room is full of people you have known too long.

ad_old_friend_bench.text: You and {{name}} sit on a park bench and argue about nothing. It is the happiest argument you've had all year.

ad_volunteer_award.text: The shelter holds a small ceremony for your years of service. There is a plaque, a cake, and one dog in a bow tie.
